name: citellm
description: Verify claims against your PDFs and inspect the exact evidence in an interactive, highlighted document viewer.

interface.longDescription: CiteLLM is the verification layer for answers from your documents. Ask ChatGPT about a PDF, such as figures from a 10-K, a clause in a contract or the key points of a report, and every answer comes with a precise citation: the page and passage it came from, highlighted in an interactive viewer. Click any answer to jump to its source and verify it in seconds. Calculated figures show their formula with each input highlighted. Review up to 20 PDFs and 100 answers at once, and export a highlighted PDF or an evidence report. Try it without an account, or sign in with Google for higher limits; your PDFs are private and temporary by default.
defaultPrompt: Answer my questions about the attached PDF with highlighted citations.
What are revenue and net income in this 10-K? Cite the source for each.
Compare the key terms in these two contracts, with citations.

positive.description: Single-document review. Setup: download https://citellm.com/samples/teledyne-employment-agreement.pdf and attach it. If ChatGPT asks to approve sending the file to CiteLLM, approve it.
positive.prompt: Verify this claim against the attached PDF and show its evidence: the executive’s annual base salary is $1,100,000.
positive.tools_triggered: citellm_read_pdf or citellm_prepare_pdf_upload; citellm_read_pdf_pages; citellm_validate_evidence; citellm_review_evidence
positive.expected_behavior: CiteLLM imports and reads the PDF, validates the quotation, and opens one viewer in which the claim is supported by the base salary clause highlighted on PDF page 2. The assessment is attributed to ChatGPT.

positive.description: Missing evidence. Setup: attach https://citellm.com/samples/teledyne-employment-agreement.pdf, which does not mention employee numbers. If ChatGPT asks to approve sending the file to CiteLLM, approve it.
positive.prompt: Does this PDF disclose the number of employees in 2030?
positive.tools_triggered: citellm_read_pdf or citellm_prepare_pdf_upload; citellm_read_pdf_pages; citellm_validate_evidence; citellm_review_evidence
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT reads all five pages and reports insufficient evidence, with no quotation and no fabricated passage.

positive.description: Compare documents. Setup: download and attach https://citellm.com/samples/apple10k.pdf and https://citellm.com/samples/nvidia10k.pdf. If ChatGPT asks to approve sending the file to CiteLLM, approve it.
positive.prompt: Compare the reported revenue in these two PDFs and highlight the source for each value.
positive.tools_triggered: citellm_read_pdf or citellm_prepare_pdf_upload; citellm_read_pdf_pages; citellm_validate_evidence; citellm_review_evidence
positive.expected_behavior: One viewer with both PDFs: Apple fiscal 2025 total net sales of $416,161 million highlighted on PDF page 33, and NVIDIA fiscal 2026 revenue of $215,938 million highlighted on PDF page 51, each with its fiscal period.

positive.description: Highlighted PDF export. Setup: complete the single-document review first, then select the viewer’s Download highlighted PDF action.
positive.prompt: Verify this claim against the attached PDF and show its evidence: the executive’s annual base salary is $1,100,000.
positive.tools_triggered: citellm_read_pdf or citellm_prepare_pdf_upload; citellm_read_pdf_pages; citellm_validate_evidence; citellm_review_evidence; citellm_export_pdf (viewer action)
positive.expected_behavior: The download is the agreement with the base salary passage highlighted on page 2, from the same review. Export is a viewer action, not an assistant tool call.

positive.description: Evidence report export. Setup: complete the single-document review first, then select the viewer’s report action with A4 paper.
positive.prompt: Verify this claim against the attached PDF and show its evidence: the executive’s annual base salary is $1,100,000.
positive.tools_triggered: citellm_read_pdf or citellm_prepare_pdf_upload; citellm_read_pdf_pages; citellm_validate_evidence; citellm_review_evidence; citellm_export_report (viewer action)
positive.expected_behavior: An A4 evidence report for the same review: the salary claim, its quotation and source page, the highlighted page, and the method. Export is a viewer action, not an assistant tool call.

negative.description: Company figure without a document. Setup: no PDF attached. CiteLLM is not invoked and no upload is requested; ChatGPT answers from general knowledge or web search.
negative.prompt: What was Apple's revenue in fiscal 2025?

negative.description: Fact-check about the world, not a user’s PDF. Setup: no PDF attached. CiteLLM is not invoked, because it verifies only against a document the user selects; ChatGPT answers from general knowledge or web search.
negative.prompt: Fact-check this: the Eiffel Tower grows taller in summer.

negative.description: PDF attached for a task other than answers or evidence. Setup: attach https://citellm.com/samples/teledyne-employment-agreement.pdf. CiteLLM is not invoked; ChatGPT handles the conversion with other tools or explains the limitation.
negative.prompt: Convert this PDF into a Word document.

publication.release_notes: Initial CiteLLM submission: PDF evidence review, source highlighting, document comparison, and viewer exports.
